name: Loop Grid Filter Suite for Elementor
author: borshidze

sections.description:
Loop Grid Filter Suite for Elementor adds two native Elementor widgets:

  • Loop Grid Live Search — instant AJAX title search for posts and WooCommerce products.
  • Loop Grid Taxonomy Filter — category, tag, product category, product tag, and public taxonomy filtering.

The original Loop Grid renders every result, so your Loop Item template, responsive columns,
pagination, query restrictions, product filters, and empty-state design remain intact. Search and
taxonomy filters can work together on the same grid without resetting each other.

Everything is available for free. There are no premium-only controls or locked features.

Elementor and WooCommerce are trademarks of their respective owners. This independent plugin is
not affiliated with or endorsed by those projects.

Created by Ilya BORSHIDZE. Telegram: https://t.me/borshidzee
Support development: https://paypal.me/BORSHIDZE

Privacy

The plugin does not collect analytics, track visitors, or contact external services automatically.
Telegram and PayPal links are opened only when an administrator explicitly clicks them.

Credits

Plugin artwork and directory assets by Ilya BORSHIDZE, licensed under GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP through Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin. Elementor and Elementor Pro must already be active.
  3. Set Advanced > CSS ID on the target Loop Grid to instant-loop-grid.
  4. Add Loop Grid Live Search and/or Loop Grid Taxonomy Filter to the same page or template.
  5. Keep the default target selector, or enter the same simple CSS ID or class in both widgets.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require Elementor Pro?

Yes. Elementor Pro is required because Loop Grid is an Elementor Pro widget. WooCommerce is optional.

Does it work with WooCommerce products?

Yes. Search matches product titles, and the taxonomy widget supports product categories and product tags.

Can search and filters be used together?

Yes. Give both widgets the same Loop Grid CSS selector. Their active conditions are combined.

Is any functionality paid?

No. The complete plugin is free and all controls are available after activation.

Does it replace my Loop Item template?

No. Elementor renders the existing Loop Grid and its original Loop Item template during AJAX updates.
